units.source_text: 虽说都是梳桃瓣发髻，可她是住在城市附近的海边温泉街，又是在艺伎馆里当佣人，她那颈后的发髻显得特别妖艳。

en.t: Although they all wore their hair in peach-petal buns, she lived in a seaside hot-spring town near the city and worked as a maid in a geisha house, so the bun at the nape of her neck looked especially seductive.

units.source_text: 艺伎的早熟和海边姑娘的健美融成一体，集中在这个姑娘身上。

en.t: The precocity of a geisha and the healthy beauty of a seaside girl had fused together and gathered in this girl.

units.source_text: 脸颊红似苹果，线条鲜明的双眼皮陪衬下的两只圆圆的眼睛，轻佻地转动着。

en.t: Her cheeks were as red as apples, and her two round eyes, set off by sharply defined double eyelids, moved about flirtatiously.

units.source_text: 山村里罕见的——这句老话，谁都会觉得新鲜。

en.t: The old phrase, rare in a mountain village, would have sounded fresh to anyone.
